feeds.title: Car Seats Mom
feeds.description: Our team of moms and trained car seat safety experts have spent thousands of hours analyzing government safety data, conducting hands-on tests, and surveying parents on the benefits and downsides to virtually every car seat model on the market. I am Keren, the founder and a mom of three young girls. I spend a lot of time in the car, therefore car safety and car seat installation are very important to me.

feeds.title: Rear Facing Blog
feeds.description: Learn about the safety benefits of our ERF car seats, the various types of car seats and how to install them. Find out about our new products and accessories and how to keep kids safer with our blog! I am Winnie and as a parent of two boys, I conducted research into car seats. I purchased an ERF car seat for my first son and have continued to use ERF seats for both my children and advocate for ERF seats with my business.

feeds.title: In Car Safety Centre Blog
feeds.description: In Car Safety Centre blog aims is to educate parents about car seat safety. Here you will find important safety information, as well as updates. In Car Safety Centre was started in 1983 as children's car seats were still relatively new and people had a lack of understanding around them. ICSC set out to teach parents about the importance of children's car seats and how to use them.

feeds.title: Car Seat Blog
feeds.description: Reviews of the safest infant, rear-facing, convertible and combination car seats for your baby, toddler or preschooler. Best practice advice, deals and coupon codes from the Experts! Welcome to CarseatBlog.com, the first internet magazine focusing on car seats! Our insightful and balanced reviews give you just what you need in your quest for what's safest for your child.

feeds.title: Car Seats For The Littles
feeds.description: Car Seats for the Littles Inc is a community-driven, education-oriented organization, staffed by child passenger safety technicians and Advocates. Follow this blog to make your child's ride in the car safer. Our website gives caregivers essential information and awareness on child safety inside a car.

feeds.title: Travel Car Seat Expert
feeds.description: Welcome to the internet's most comprehensive resource on how to travel with car seats! Learn about best travel car seats, hacks and flying with a car seat. I'm Melissa, a real-life mom of two, world traveler and Child Passenger Safety Technician. I love helping parents travel more, better and easier and that's what this whole website is about.

feeds.title: Safe in the Seat Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Michelle, proud mom of two. I couldn't find a go-to resource to help me navigate the complex part of my child's safety so I became the expert I needed & founded Safe in the Seat in 2018. Visit the Safe in the Seat blog to know about car seat 101, how to choose the right seat, and travelling with kids.

feeds.title: Best Baby Car Seats Reviews Blog
feeds.description: The Best Baby Car Seat Reviews blog focuses on providing detailed information about the best and safest baby car seats. It includes information about the different types of car seats, their features, and how to choose the right one. This blog also provides useful advice for parents looking for a safe place for their babies to sit in their cars.
